experiments.title: Demo call link in the carousel first comment
experiments.hypothesis: We believe that a demo call link in the first comment of each carousel will move booked demo calls because the queue shows carousels as the posts with the most profile visits.
experiments.change: content-publisher adds the booking page as the link of every carousel post for two weeks.

experiments.title: Retargeting ads to the apply page visitors
experiments.hypothesis: We believe that two retargeting ads will move apply page visits because the landing audit found the apply page converts once reached.
experiments.change: static-ads-builder renders two BOFU ads; the founder imports them PAUSED and starts them.

experiments.title: Follow-up email to unanswered first touches
experiments.hypothesis: We believe that one follow-up to unanswered first touches will move replies because the outreach state shows most contacts got one touch only.
experiments.change: cold-outreach-builder drafts one follow-up per unanswered contact; the founder sends them from the sequencer.

usage: Fictional fixture of the growth-sprint selftest: three AARRR experiments, input of the next sprint.
